description__en: A harvested fruit sells for its crop's base value, scaled by its size and its mutation. The community wiki publishes the size rule; we have not tested it in the game ourselves.
definition__en: A harvested fruit sells for its crop's base value, scaled by its size and its mutation. The community wiki publishes the size rule; we have not tested it in the game ourselves.

description__en: Value grows with (weight / base weight) to the power 2.5 for most crops (Mushroom and Bamboo use a smaller power). Fruits below the smallest size still sell as that size.
definition__en: Value grows with (weight / base weight) to the power 2.5 for most crops (Mushroom and Bamboo use a smaller power). Fruits below the smallest size still sell as that size.

description__en: Each mutation has a fixed Sheckle multiplier.
definition__en: Each mutation has a fixed Sheckle multiplier.

description__en: A crop carries only one mutation at a time, so mutations never stack in Grow a Garden 2.
definition__en: A crop carries only one mutation at a time, so mutations never stack in Grow a Garden 2.

description__en: Fruit stays fresh for a set time after harvest, then slowly loses value as it decays. Watering or rain stops decay, and mutated fruit does not decay. Our calculator shows the fresh value.
definition__en: Fruit stays fresh for a set time after harvest, then slowly loses value as it decays. Watering or rain stops decay, and mutated fruit does not decay. Our calculator shows the fresh value.
